property_summary: For every caller address, calling settle() before locking in a guess must revert (since the reference requires a nonzero recorded block), while the mutant allows settle() to proceed harmlessly and still revert later or succeed only in effects that are not settleable; the property is that a settle() call from an address with no recorded guess must revert, which the reference satisfies for all inputs and the bug breaks for some address with no guess.
change_summary: Delete the first require so settle can be called even when the caller has no recorded guess.
